heading: ChatGPT Watermark Remover for Visible Marks on Images
intro: Need to remove a visible label, draft stamp, or overlay from an image you created with ChatGPT? WatermarkGemini helps clean image pixels without cropping away the full frame. Upload a JPG, PNG, or WebP you are allowed to edit, review the cost after sign-in, and inspect the returned JPG. This tool does not remove ChatGPT text watermarks, C2PA Content Credentials, or invisible SynthID signals. Illustrative comparisons are not tested product results.

process.heading: How to Remove a Visible Mark from a ChatGPT Image
process.intro: If your ChatGPT-created image contains a visible added label or stamp, follow this image-only workflow. Original AI provenance signals are outside the scope of visible pixel cleanup.

steps.title: Choose Your ChatGPT Image
steps.description: Select one original JPG, PNG or WebP file up to 10 MB that you own or have permission to edit. Keep a copy of the untouched image so you can compare the visible overlay and surrounding texture later.

steps.title: Sign In and Review the Cost
steps.description: Open the image workspace, sign in with Google, and check the processing cost and any eligible free image uses. Start the visible-mark cleanup when the file and cost are acceptable; this does not scan or strip C2PA or SynthID.

steps.title: Compare and Download Your Result
steps.description: Check the cleaned area at full size for altered letters, edges, repeating patterns, or blurry patches. If the returned JPG is suitable for your project, download it and retain the original separately.

faq.heading: ChatGPT Watermark Remover FAQs
faq.intro: Answers about visible marks, image uploads, text watermark searches, hidden provenance signals, fees, and responsible editing.

items.question: What does a ChatGPT watermark remover actually remove?
items.answer: This page targets a visible label, stamp, logo, or text overlay in the pixels of an image that you own or may edit. It does not change the origin of that image, and it does not remove invisible provenance signals.

items.question: How do I remove a visible watermark from a ChatGPT image?
items.answer: Upload one JPG, PNG, or WebP image up to 10 MB, sign in with Google, review the displayed processing cost, and run the image cleanup. Compare the returned JPG against the original at full size before downloading.

items.question: Can I remove a ChatGPT watermark from copied text?
items.answer: No. This is an image upload tool, not a ChatGPT text watermark remover. It cannot process copied responses, prompts, documents, or invisible text-level patterns. A separate text question needs a different, evidence-based answer.

items.question: Does ChatGPT put a visible logo on every generated image?
items.answer: No universal visible-logo claim is appropriate. Images can have an added visible label or overlay, but OpenAI also documents provenance signals that are not ordinary corner graphics. Check the actual pixels of your image before choosing a visible-mark editor.

items.question: Does this remove C2PA metadata or invisible SynthID watermarks?
items.answer: No. WatermarkGemini's visible-image workflow does not detect or remove C2PA Content Credentials or SynthID. OpenAI describes these as different provenance signals and provides a public verification tool for supported files.

items.question: Does it work with GPT Image 2.5 and newer ChatGPT images?
items.answer: It can be used for a supported image file that contains a visible unwanted overlay you are authorized to edit, regardless of which ChatGPT image model produced the visual. Model names do not guarantee a particular visible mark or cleanup result. The tool does not erase the file's AI provenance.

items.question: Is this a free ChatGPT watermark remover?
items.answer: Eligible standard image operations can use limited free image uses: one after first Google sign-in and another through daily check-in, with a maximum free-use balance of three. Review the cost on the processing button; unlimited free removal is not promised.

items.question: Which image formats and sizes are supported?
items.answer: The dedicated image workflow accepts one JPG, PNG, or WebP file up to 10 MB and currently returns a JPG. It is not a PDF, text, URL, or batch-image processor; a separate video workspace handles supported MP4 files.

items.question: Can I remove a visible mark without cropping or blurring?
items.answer: The image workflow edits the visible area rather than relying on a crop, but repaired pixels can still show softness or texture differences. Check the original dimensions, lettering, faces, product details, and the edited corner before reuse.

items.question: Do I need to sign in, and is the upload private?
items.answer: You can choose and preview a file locally first. Google sign-in is required before processing, and your selected file is then uploaded to a private temporary processing workflow. Site materials state that files and results are generally scheduled for deletion around 24 hours; check the Privacy Policy before uploading confidential content.

items.question: Is WatermarkGemini an official OpenAI or ChatGPT tool?
items.answer: No. WatermarkGemini is an independent editing service, not affiliated with or endorsed by OpenAI. Use it only on images you own or have permission to edit, and preserve any required AI-origin attribution or disclosures.

features.heading: Visible Image Cleanup, with Clear Limits
features.intro: A useful ChatGPT image watermark remover should distinguish an unwanted visible overlay from invisible source information. Focus the edit on what you can see, preserve your composition, and inspect the details rather than assuming that every kind of watermark can be removed.

items.heading: Remove a Visible Draft Label Without Cropping
items.description: An approved ChatGPT-generated poster or social graphic may have a draft label added during review. Cropping to hide it can cut off the headline or change the aspect ratio. WatermarkGemini edits the visible area within the original image frame, so you can keep the layout and compare the repaired corner before reuse.

items.afterImageAlt: Illustrative after view of the same magnifying-glass still life without that mark.

items.heading: Check Fine Textures Around the Edited Area
items.description: Labels across hair, clothing, product packaging, or gradients are harder to clean than marks on a flat wall. The image workspace aims to reconstruct surrounding pixels rather than replace the corner with a blurred block. Inspect fine print, repeated patterns, and edges: an AI repair can change details and is not guaranteed to match the original pixels.

items.afterImageAlt: Illustrative after view of the same illustration without that mark.

items.heading: Work Online with a Clear Upload-to-Download Flow
items.description: Choose one supported image in your browser, sign in with Google, review the task cost, process, then compare the returned JPG. This saves you from manually rebuilding a small visible overlay in a desktop editor, but the image is uploaded for cloud processing after you sign in; it is not an entirely local operation.

items.heading: Know What the Tool Cannot Remove
items.description: A ChatGPT image can contain provenance signals beyond what is visible on the screen. This page does not read, erase, or verify C2PA Content Credentials or SynthID, and it cannot change invisible watermarks in copied text. Keep relevant AI-origin disclosures and use OpenAI's official verification resources if you need to inspect supported provenance signals.
